tagline: A river city of mill ruins, theatres and skyways, with lakes and trails on the doorstep and summers worth the winter.

events.name: Art-A-Whirl
events.desc: Artists across the Northeast Minneapolis Arts District open their studios to the public for a long weekend.

events.name: Twin Cities Pride
events.desc: A big, free Pride festival in Loring Park, with a parade along Hennepin Avenue.

events.name: Minneapolis Aquatennial
events.desc: A summer festival of river, lake and street events, including the Torchlight Parade on Nicollet Mall.

events.name: Twin Cities Marathon
events.desc: A marathon from downtown Minneapolis past the lakes and along the river to the State Capitol in St. Paul.
